query: Which imaging modalities and metrics (SEM, confocal profilometry, micro-CT) best quantify pile-up/sink-in, lateral cracking, and subsurface damage for contact-area correction?

response.query: Which imaging modalities and metrics (SEM, confocal profilometry, micro-CT) best quantify pile-up/sink-in, lateral cracking, and subsurface damage for contact-area correction?
response.answer: SEM, confocal profilometry, and micro-CT best quantify pile-up/sink-in, lateral cracking, and subsurface damage. These techniques provide high-resolution imaging and detailed surface analysis.
